units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nedarim 3:1:3">Y. Ned. III, beg. 37ᵈ</cite> <he>ח׳ עליה מותנא</he>. tied a rope around it, i.e. made the law more stringent. Bab.
<cite ref="Nedarim 49b:9">Ned. 49ᵇ</cite> <he>וחוֹגְרַנִי צדעי</he> (Rashi: <he>וחוגר אני</he>, Ar. <he>וה׳</he>) and I had my forehead tied up.
